title: The Staircase of Ethics: Probing LLM Value Priorities through Multi-Step Induction to Complex Moral Dilemmas

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM decision-making across progressive 5-stage ethical conflicts using the Multi-step Moral Dilemmas (MMDs) dataset to measure pairwise preferences, value shifts, and transitivity among values defined by Moral Foundations Theory (e.g., Care, Fairness) and Schwartz's Theory of Basic Values (e.g., Universalism, Security).
